full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white press photograph shows a woman in dark clothing held at the center of a close, crowded nighttime scene. She turns her pale face toward a man at the right who raises a camera near her shoulder; his light flat cap fills part of the upper foreground. Several other men press in from the left and behind, their hats and faces emerging only partially from deep shadow. The woman's dark hair and lipstick are carefully visible, but there is no studio polish or calm portrait spacing. A hard on-camera flash lights her face and the nearest cap, then falls rapidly into almost black surrounding coats. Bodies overlap so densely that the frame feels compressed, and the camera lens at right becomes a second point of attention. The photograph has coarse grain and slightly imperfect tonal transitions typical of hurried low-light recording. The crowd's expressions are curious, intent and difficult to read; no single clear incident or headline is specified. The visible event is the act of being photographed under pressure. The crop cuts off shoulders and heads at every edge, making the public intrusion palpable. The image feels urgent and unarranged, with the harsh light, dark void and tight human spacing delivering a candid urban narrative.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅正方形黑白新闻照片呈现夜间拥挤场景中央一位穿深衣的女子。她把苍白面孔转向右侧举起相机的男子；男子的浅色鸭舌帽占据一部分上方前景。更多男人从左边和后方挤入，帽子与面孔只在深影中部分显现。女子深发与唇色清楚可见，但没有影棚修饰或平静肖像间距。相机闪光把她的脸和最近的帽子打亮，然后迅速落入周围外套的近黑色。身体密集相叠，使画框感觉被挤压，右侧相机镜头成为第二视觉点。照片有粗颗粒和略不完美的灰阶过渡，像仓促的弱光记录。人群神情好奇、专注又难以完全读懂；画面没有指定某件明确事件或标题。可见事件本身是被围住并受压拍摄。肩膀和头在每边被裁断，使公共空间的侵入感具体可触。图像紧迫且未布置，强闪光、深暗空处与密集的人体间距构成率直城市叙事。
style_prompt_en: The style is candid black-and-white tabloid-era flash photography with harsh frontal illumination, rapidly falling dark backgrounds and very tight human overlap. Pale highlights on nearest forms contrast with crushed coat blacks and coarse analog grain. Cropped edges and irregular spacing convey crowd pressure; slight tonal roughness preserves urgency. A square frame concentrates multiple competing gazes and a central flash-lit plane. The image remains documentary and immediate rather than arranged or beautified.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格是率直的旧式小报记者黑白闪光摄影，具有尖锐正面照明、迅速坠入黑暗的背景和非常紧密的人体叠压。最近形体上的浅亮部对应几乎压实的外套黑色与粗胶片颗粒。裁断边缘和不规则间距传达人群压力，轻微灰阶粗糙性保留紧迫感。正方形画框集中多道互相竞争的视线与中央受闪光照亮的平面。图像纪实即时，不经安排或美化。
theme_en: A woman surrounded by a nighttime press crowd
theme_zh: 夜间被记者人群围住的女子
name: Weegee
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
